subject: Post-demo MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement checkpoints
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Ellie Zhang <ellie.zhang@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement checkpoints

Hi Ellie —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through Redwood’s inference platform. Per our call, I pulled together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft focused on the vendor onboarding / procurement milestone so your procurement and finance teams can see owners, dates, and dependencies. Please review and call out any changes.

Proposed MAP milestone summary (target close: 2027-07-02):
- 1) Vendor enrollment in Ariba or Coupa
  • Owner: NovaCorp Procurement (Ellie / Paul)
  • Redwood action: Provide vendor info form + Ariba setup instructions (attached)
  • Target: 2027-06-14
- 2) W-9 submission & validation
  • Owner: NovaCorp (Ellie)
  • Redwood action: Confirm receipt & forward to Finance
  • Target: 2027-06-16
- 3) Banking / ACH details & micro-deposit verification
  • Owner: NovaCorp Treasury
  • Redwood action: Share remittance/vendor ID formats and verification steps
  • Target: 2027-06-21
- 4) PO issuance / contract signature (legal & procurement)
  • Owner: NovaCorp Legal & Procurement / Redwood Legal
  • Dependency: Completed vendor enrollment + PO request
  • Target: 2027-06-28
- 5) Go-live (first production invoices enabled)
  • Owner: NovaCorp Finance / Redwood Customer Success
  • Target: 2027-07-02

Key dependencies: NovaCorp completes Ariba/Coupa registration, W-9, and banking verification. If Procurement requires Coupa-only onboarding, we’ll add a short handoff step to coordinate both portals.

Attachments (attached to this email): Redwood_Vendor_Info_Form.pdf (stub), Ariba_Setup_Instructions.pdf (stub).

Next steps / asks:
1) Please confirm the internal owners (procurement contact + finance contact) and whether NovaCorp uses Ariba, Coupa, or both.
2) If possible, attach the completed W-9 and a remittance/banking contact by 2027-06-10.
3) Would you be open to a 30-minute procurement kickoff on 2027-06-11 to run through the Ariba checklist and handoffs?

I’ll update the MAP in HubSpot once we have confirmations.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0178

---
From: Ellie Zhang <ellie.zhang@novacorp.com>

Cc: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo MAP: Vendor onboarding & procurement checkpoints

Nikhil —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. Attaching our completed W-9 and a PDF with banking details. A couple quick notes:
- We primarily use Ariba but we do have an instance of Coupa for one of our business units; Procurement would prefer Ariba for this engagement if Redwood supports it.
- Our procurement lead is Paul Reynolds (cc’d). He’ll own the PO issuance and vendor enrollment.
- Our finance team prefers Net-45 terms; is that acceptable or do you require Net-30?

We can do the 30-minute kickoff on 2027-06-11 at 10:00am PT — Paul and I are available. If that works, please send a calendar invite.

Attached: W-9_NovaCorp.pdf (stub), Bank_Details_NovaCorp.pdf (stub).

Thanks,
Ellie Zhang
Sr. Procurement Manager | NovaCorp
ellie.zhang@novacorp.com

Ellie / Nikhil —

Quick finance note from our side: we support vendor setup via Ariba and Coupa. For Ariba we’ll provide the SSO-friendly supplier onboarding docs; for Coupa we can accept the punchout/vendor enrollment fields typically required. A few ask items from Redwood Finance to speed verification:
- W-9 (received) — we will validate and confirm tax ID internally
- Bank account PDF or bank letter for ACH (we can accept a redacted statement)
- Remittance address and an invoice email address

If NovaCorp can send the remittance address and invoice contact today, we’ll prepare the PO template for Paul to sign after the kickoff. I’m copying Ben (Payments) to coordinate micro-deposit verification if needed.

I’ll attach our onboarding pack to this thread with the exact field list.

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Pack.xlsx (stub).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
VP, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
